0.0: I see you've reached #bLv. 50#k, and right on schedule, too. I've prepared a few items I thought would assist you in your adventures. Would you like them right now?

no.0: I'll keep the box here for you until you get to Lv. 59, then. After that, it's getting recycled, so don't wait too long.

yes.0: Good! Because I already placed them in your inventory while you weren't paying attention!
